questions.stem: What is the angle between the two straight lines $y=(2-\sqrt{3}) x+5$ and $y=(2+\sqrt{3}) x-7 ?$
questions.solution: The slopes have product $(2-\sqrt3)(2+\sqrt3)=1$ and difference $2\sqrt3$. Therefore $\tan\theta=|m_2-m_1|/|1+m_1m_2|=\sqrt3$, giving the acute angle $60^\circ$.
